outputs.task_summary: Implement GitHub Issue #8: Define a standardized WorkspaceEvent interface in src/types/index.ts with fields (type, timestamp, actor, workspaceId, payload), add a WorkspaceEventType enum with 7 event type constants, update the workspace_events DB schema and queries to store/retrieve the new fields, consolidate four duplicate emitEvent() helpers into one centralized emitWorkspaceEvent() in src/core/, and ensure all lifecycle points emit the correct typed events (workspace.created, workspace.prepared, workspace.started, workspace.snapshot_created, workspace.lock_acquired, workspace.lock_released, workspace.cleaned).

complexity_profile.refactoring: consolidate 4 duplicate emitEvent helpers into 1 centralized function
risk_areas: DB schema migration: workspace_events table needs new columns (type, timestamp, actor, payload) while preserving backward compatibility with existing rows

Event name changes: workspace.locked → workspace.lock_acquired, workspace.unlocked → workspace.lock_released, workspace.bound → workspace.started, workspace.snapshot.created → workspace.snapshot_created
Workspace.prepared event: currently workspace.created is emitted after status update to 'prepared' — need to split into two distinct events
Actor field: must be threaded through all core functions (createWorkspace, lockWorkspace, unlockWorkspace, cleanupWorkspace, createSnapshot, bindRun)

summary: Intake analysis complete. Task is to standardize the Workspace Event schema per Issue #8. Scope: medium — touches types (new interface + enum), DB schema (column migration), queries (updated CRUD), and all 4 core modules (workspace.ts, lock.ts, cleanup.ts, snapshot.ts) to consolidate duplicate helpers and emit 7 standardized event types. Key risks: DB migration compatibility and threading the new 'actor' parameter through all core functions.
